findings.title: Fallback translations are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: The lazy translation loader only loads the current locale during `I18n.translate`; a fallback lookup performed by `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` reads the fallback locale directly from the backend and does not invoke `I18n.translate` again. This callback preloads fallback locales only for requests that pass through `ApplicationController`. Mailers, background jobs, model/service code, and any other `I18n.t` call outside that controller will therefore load (for example) `fr` but not the configured site locale or `en`, so missing French strings still resolve as missing translations on a cold process. Fallback locale loading needs to happen as part of translation/fallback resolution rather than only in this controller filter.

findings.title: Translation cache does not include the dynamic fallback chain
findings.body: A no-options translation is cached only by key, current locale, and backend object. The new fallback result also depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which can be changed at runtime, but this change adds no cache invalidation for that setting. After changing the site default locale, keys absent from a user's locale can continue returning the old default locale's cached text until the entry is evicted or I18n is reloaded, producing stale and inconsistent server-rendered translations.
